---
title: "Compte rendu de commission"
output:
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
geometry: "a4paper,margin=2cm"
fontsize: 10pt
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{fontspec}
  - \setmainfont{DejaVu Serif}
params:
  cr: !r list()
  mots: !r data.frame()
  n: 100
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
esc = parlementR:::.echapper_latex_senateurs
```

```{r metadonnees, results='asis'}
cr = params$cr
cat("\\textbf{Commission / intitulé :} ", esc(cr$titre), "\\par\n", sep = "")
cat("\\textbf{Référence d'organe :} ", esc(cr$commission_ref), "\\par\n", sep = "")
cat("\\textbf{Date :} ", if (is.na(cr$date)) "Non renseignée" else format(cr$date, "%d/%m/%Y"), "\\par\n", sep = "")
cat("\\textbf{Sujet :} ", esc(cr$sujet), "\\par\n", sep = "")
cat("\\textbf{Intervenants mentionnés dans le texte (repérage automatique, non exhaustif) :} ", esc(paste(cr$intervenants_mentions, collapse = ", ")), "\\par\n", sep = "")
cat("\\textbf{Source :} ", esc(cr$url), "\\par\n", sep = "")
```

## Nuage de mots

```{r nuage, fig.width=9, fig.height=5.5, out.width='100%'}
parlementR::nuage_compte_rendu_an(params$mots, n = params$n)
```

\newpage

# Compte rendu intégral

```{r texte, results='asis'}
paragraphes = strsplit(cr$texte, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
paragraphes = trimws(paragraphes)
paragraphes = paragraphes[nzchar(paragraphes)]
for (p in paragraphes) cat(esc(p), "\\par\n", sep = "")
```
